phase_note: Descriptive characterization is complete for the pure-tumor sample. Evaluation design has not started. The website and research-OS implementation stream is paused as of 2026-08-19; active work is literature positioning and evaluation-metric definition.
research_question: What information is still missing before tumor-only ClairS-TO candidates can be evaluated as reliable MRD markers?
working_hypothesis: PASS plus adequate depth and ALT support reduces technical noise but does not by itself establish somatic status; an explicit SNV-only baseline and a defined recognition metric are required before any incremental-evidence claim can be tested.
next_meeting_note: Not recorded yet. Set `next_meeting` in research/research-os.json after the date is agreed.

critical_issues.title: Candidate composition is unknown
critical_issues.detail: The somatic, germline and technical-artifact composition of the 48,819 PASS SNV candidates has not been determined.

critical_issues.title: “Tumor recognition” is not yet an evaluation metric
critical_issues.detail: No measurable definition of tumor-signal recognition exists, so no method can currently be scored against another.

critical_issues.title: No SNV-only baseline is specified
critical_issues.detail: Incremental value of any additional evidence modality is undefined until the SNV-only baseline is fixed.

critical_issues.title: Phase and methylation contribution is untested
critical_issues.detail: Phase and native methylation evidence may be complementary, redundant or unhelpful. This must be tested through an ablation, not assumed.

guardrails: PASS is a caller retention label, not confirmed somatic truth.
Filtered is not equivalent to false positive.
High coverage in the source sample is not low-tumor-fraction sensitivity.
No claim that phase or methylation improves tumor recognition before a baseline, an evaluation metric and an ablation exist.
